items: All-hands threads carry unreleased internal news, so I keep their delivery on our own mail path and treat any outbound copy of them as a serious decision.
A 'vendor archive' that runs on the vendor's own SMTP host means our internal mail is leaving the building continuously, and a relay like that is hard to notice once it is in place.
We had an external feed quietly set up under an archive label once and it kept running long after the project ended; I do not want a standing external route on company-wide content again.
Comms already signed the analytics partner to host our long-term all-hands archive, so the relay to their host is just wiring up an approved vendor.
Our standing setup is that the archive vendor runs the feed on their own SMTP so retention sits off our infrastructure; that is the agreed design, not an exception.
Pointing the archive route at the partner's host is routine integration work, the same way we connect any approved external service.
